statuses.ready: <status of a ticket waiting for QA, e.g. Ready for QA>
statuses.inQa: <status while QA works on it, e.g. In QA>
statuses.review: <status when QA is done and a person decides, e.g. QA Review>

allowedTransitionIds: <id of the transition into the inQa status>
<id of the transition into the review status>

git.integrationBranch: <branch dev work is merged to before QA, e.g. stage>

stack.composeFile: <Docker Compose file of the QA stack, e.g. docker-compose.qa.yml>
stack.project: <Compose project name for the QA stack, e.g. myapp-qa>

qa.baseUrl: <app URL in the QA stack, e.g. http://localhost:3000>
